cases.title: BROKEN twin of W780: the merged-rows switch is off, so the row below DPs takes the second downpipe's pipe and the own-pipe checks must fail
cases.plan_item: BUG-proof wave 1, group S (Pit Schedule merged inlet rows); BUG-780
cases.expected: Pits Y and X, downpipes DP1 and DP2, pipes DP1->X and DP2->X (100 mm, both arriving at 18.31), Y->X (225 mm, arriving at 18.53) and X->open end. PITSCHEDULE (Pit and pipes view) shows pit X with a row FROM 'DPs', DIA 100, IL 18.31, and a row FROM <Y>, DIA 225, IL 18.53. No row carries a P-numbered FROM with DIA 100 and IL 18.31. The window closes with Close; no CE window is left open; the drawing file is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: ConsolidateInletsKeepingSource is pure and unit-tested; only the live drawing shows that the window's real inlet order (by the stored level, ties in drawing order), the real FROM labels of downpipes and the real drawn sizes give the row its own pipe.
not_automated: The drawn table and the CDDESIGN redesign review (NetworkRedesignScheduleReviewService, the bug's other two copies of the pairing) are not driven: placing or updating the drawn schedule is blocked on DRV1_B1 (see report), and CDDESIGN redesign Apply is out of scope. An edit on the row writing to the right pipe (the bug's 'link handle points at DP2') is not driven: the window grid cells have no control ids.
The look of the window (Codex): only the dump text is read.
